original.target_description: Experiment 3; zoo-trip compliance; rejection-moderation condition versus combined equivalent-request and smaller-request-only controls; planned orthogonal chi-square contrast.

n.sample_role: Participants in each of three conditions
n.exclusions: No participant complied with the extreme request. Eight accepted the initial equivalent request and were retained.

es.quote: The second tested the rejection-moderation condition against the combined controls; a marginally significant difference occurred, χ² = 2.88, p = .091.

p.quote: The second tested the rejection-moderation condition against the combined controls; a marginally significant difference occurred, χ² = 2.88, p = .091.

replication.target_description: Direct replication of Study 3; zoo-trip compliance; p. 15 exploratory comparison of rejection-moderation versus combined controls, excluding participants agreeing to any first request.

n.location: Accepted manuscript p. 15, Non-preregistered explorative analyses
n.quote: Thus, we repeated the previous analyses without participants who agreed to any of the first requests.
n.sample_role: Participants in all three conditions after exploratory exclusions; target analytic n not printed

es.location: Accepted manuscript p. 15, Non-preregistered explorative analyses
es.quote: Replicating the previous findings, participants in the rejection-moderation condition (51.28 %) complied more often with the small request than participants in the control conditions (24.68 %), χ² = 24.64, p < .001.

notes: Original p. 7 corresponds to printed p. 212. Replication locator p. 15 selects the exploratory test excluding agreement with either initial request. The preregistered combined-controls test on p. 14 instead prints χ² = 10.82, p = .001 with whole-study analytic N = 391; it is a different sample/test and is not merged with the p. 15 result. Exploratory analytic n is left null rather than calculated.
